description: Starter stacks from aitools.obzdn.co/stacks/: the main jobs for one kind of business (a plumber, a new salon, a consultant...), each done by an OBZDN top pick on a named plan, with the monthly total copied from each tool's own pricing page. Give an id for one stack, or leave it out to list them (optionally by audience).

audience.description: Optional audience id to filter the list, e.g. trades, local, pros, creators, marketers

id.description: A stack id, e.g. plumber-under-100 or new-salon-free

name: get_stack
title: Get a starter stack of AI tools for a kind of business
